headline: US Treasury Yields Fall in Biggest Daily Drop Since 2023 Banking Crisis
summary: US Treasury yields registered their largest decline since the March 2023 banking crisis as the artificial-intelligence trade faltered and economic concerns surfaced. The yield on the 10-year Treasury note led the decline.
why: US Treasury yields serve as global benchmark interest rates, influencing borrowing costs, equity valuations, and capital allocation across global financial markets.

impacts.name: US 10-Year Treasury Yield
impacts.why: Increased investor demand for fixed-income safe havens drove bond prices higher and yield benchmarks lower.

why_moved: Treasury yields dropped sharply as market sentiment turned cautious regarding the artificial intelligence sector, sparking increased demand for safe-haven government bonds.
